name: 吳昭正
objective: 布林代數與邏輯閘，組合邏輯，算術演算邏輯，同步循序邏輯，演繹狀態機，非同步循序邏輯。
schedule:
Week 1(9/7、9). Introduction、Number systems (I)
Week 2(9/14、16). Number systems(II)、Boolean Algebra (I)
Week 3(9/21、23). Boolean Algebra (II)
Week 4(9/28、9/30). Holiday、Boolean Algebra (III)
Week 5(10/5、7). Applications of Boolean algebra minterm and maxterm expansions
Week 6(10/12、14). Karnaugh Maps (I)
Week 7(10/19、21). Karnaugh Maps (II)、Quine-McClusky Method(I)
Week 8(10/26、28). Holiday、Quine-McClusky Method(II)
Week 9(11/2). Midterm Exam
Week 10(11/9、11). Holiday、Multi-Level Gate Circuits NAND and NOR Gates(I)
Week 11(11/16、18). Multi-Level Gate Circuits NAND and NOR Gates(II)、Latches and Flip-Flops (I)
Week 12(11/23、25). Latches and Flip-Flops (II)
Week 13(11/30、12/2). Registers and Counters(I)
Week 14(12/7、9). Registers and Counters(I)、State Machines (I)
Week 15(12/14、16). State Machines (II)
Week 16(12/21、23). Final Exam
scorePolicy:
Homework exams: 30%
Circuit Design: 10%
Midterm: 30%
Final exam: 30%
Attendance: -1% for each absence recorded
Bonus (if available): 10%
Total: 110%
materials:

Fundamentals of Logic Design Enhanced, 7th Edition, by Charles H. Roth, Jr. , Larry L. Kinney , Eugene B. John, Pearson FT Press, 2020
延伸教學與資源:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI:
● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
